Reference / io/transfer

io/transfer#

A source read to its end, and bytes carried from a source to a destination (#130), so that modules stop repeating the read loop:

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let body = await ReadUntilEnd(origin: reader, limit: 1048576).bytes();
let note = await ReadUntilEnd(origin: reader, limit: 65536).text();
let count = await Copy(from: reader, to: writer).count();

Description#

A source read to its end, and bytes carried from a source to a destination (#130), so that modules stop repeating the read loop:

Both take a Reading or an AsyncReading, and Copy a Writing or an AsyncWriting. ReadUntilEnd gives at most limit bytes: a source with more throws ReadLimitExceeded once it has given limit + 1 of them, and is not read further. Copy carries everything, 64 KiB at a time, and neither flushes nor closes either side.

Every byte up to the end. A source that ends after its first piece hands that piece out as it is; longer ones are joined once.
